concepts.display: A concern that is still being tracked.

A concern that is active, but which may be set aside. For example, this value might be used to suspend concern about a patient problem after some period of remission, but before assumption that the concern has been resolved.

A concern that is no longer actively being tracked, but for reasons other than because the problem was resolved. This value might be used to mark a concern as being aborted after a patient leaves care against medical advice.
The problem, allergy or medical state has been resolved and the concern no longer needs to be tracked except for historical purposes.
